# Trafalgar

> > Trafalgar offers guided vacation tours across Europe, North America, and beyond, featuring cultural heritage experiences, national parks, and multi-country itineraries.

Trafalgar is a guided tour operator under The Travel Corporation (TTC Portfolio of Brands), specializing in immersive travel experiences with unique offerings like Be My Guest and Stays with Stories. Their tours range from 7-day regional explorations to 18-day multi-country journeys across destinations including London, Paris, Rome, Vienna, Ireland, Scotland, Austria, Portugal, and Canada.

## Key Topics

- Guided tours
- Europe tours
- Multi-country tours
- Cultural heritage experiences
- Historical sites
- National park tours
- Be My Guest experiences
- Stays with Stories
- Group travel (9+ people)
- Solo travel tours
- Vacation packages
- The Travel Corporation (TTC)
- First-class tours
- City breaks
- Senior travel (60+)

## Featured European Tours

- [Traditional Europe Tour 2026](https://www.trafalgar.com/en-us/tours/traditional-europe): 18-day multi-destination tour from Amsterdam to French Riviera via Alps
- [Best of Britain Tour 2026](https://www.trafalgar.com/en-us/tours/best-of-britain): 14-day UK tour covering England, Scotland, and Wales highlights
- [Switzerland & Austria Tour](https://www.trafalgar.com/en-us/tours/switzerland-and-austria): 13-day Alpine tour through Vienna, Salzburg, and Swiss destinations
- [Highlights of Germany Tour](https://www.trafalgar.com/en-us/tours/highlights-of-germany): 8-day guided tour from Berlin to Munich via Dresden and Nuremberg
- [Treasures of France including Normandy Tour](https://www.trafalgar.com/en-us/tours/treasures-of-france-including-normandy): 8-day France tour featuring D-Day beaches, Loire Valley, and Paris
- [Balkan Adventure Tour](https://www.trafalgar.com/en-us/tours/balkan-adventure): 14-day Eastern Europe tour from Bucharest to Sarajevo via Balkans

## North America Tours

- [East Coast USA & Canada Tour](https://www.trafalgar.com/en-us/tours/east-coast-usa-and-canada): 14-day tour from NYC through DC, Ottawa, Toronto, and Niagara Falls
- [Charms of Southeast USA Tour](https://www.trafalgar.com/en-us/tours/charms-of-southeast-usa): 7-day guided tour from Charleston to Jekyll Island exploring Gullah culture
- [Canada's Rockies Tour](https://www.trafalgar.com/en-us/tours/canada-s-rockies): 7-day tour from Calgary to Vancouver through Banff and Jasper parks
- [Hawaiian Explorer First Class Tour](https://www.trafalgar.com/en-us/tours/hawaiian-explorer): 8-day first-class Hawaii tour visiting Honolulu, Maui, and Pearl Harbor
- [National Park Tours & Nature Travel](https://www.trafalgar.com/en-us/ways-to-go/national-park-tours): Guided tours to Grand Canyon, Yellowstone, Glacier, and Banff parks

## Travel Styles & Experiences

- [One-of-a-kind Experiences](https://www.trafalgar.com/en-us/about-us/one-of-a-kind-experiences): Company overview of unique experiences like Be My Guest and Stays with Stories
- [Group Trips for 9+ People](https://www.trafalgar.com/en-us/ways-to-go/group-tours/group-trips): Custom group travel for 9+ with trip organizer support and flexible booking
- [Travel Tours for Singles Over 60](https://www.trafalgar.com/en-us/ways-to-go/solo-travel/singles-over-60-tours): Senior solo travel tours with room-share options for singles over 60
- [City Breaks & Shopping Trips](https://www.trafalgar.com/en-us/ways-to-go/shopping-city-breaks): Shopping-focused city tours in London, Paris, New York and more
- [4th of July Getaways & Vacation Packages](https://www.trafalgar.com/en-us/ways-to-go/4th-of-july): Independence Day vacation packages and summer holiday getaway tours
